title: Functorial global-section cochain map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F,G$ abelian sheaves, $I,J$ injective resolutions, and $\varphi:I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ a cochain map. The map of section complexes $A(I)\to A(J)$ [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction] has degree-$n$ component $\varphi^n(X)$, the map on sections over the whole space.
